concept_v1.png.prompt: The attached image is an APPROVED app design, given only as a style reference. Design a NEW launcher icon for this app in the SAME visual language: its palette (#6041B4,#F7F5FC,#9D7BF4,#110F14), rendering style, lighting and mood. Do NOT reproduce the screenshot or any illustration or scene in it (no landscape, horizon, water or card); invent a simple icon composition. Brief: Xiaomi Remote: a calm, premium phone remote for an Android TV box (Mi Box S). Design language 'Violet Quiet': soft violet, rounded, quiet confidence. Direction: a minimal circular D-pad ring with a glowing OK centre, flat emblem on a deep violet gradient. Square 1:1 canvas. FULL-BLEED: the background fills the entire square edge to edge; no rounded corners, no border or frame, no drop shadow, no device, no mockup, no UI elements. One bold, simple central subject with a strong silhouette that still reads at 48 px, centred and about 60% of the canvas wide so circular masks never cut it, on a solid or smooth-gradient background with little or no texture. No text, letters or numbers anywhere.
